title: Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0 of the Republic of Moldova
organization: Government of the Republic of Moldova; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Submitted 6 May 2025; subnational risk index cited is from 2023, with historical impacts and a non-time-specific rainfall outlook.
methodology: Government NDC synthesizes climate, social-risk and adaptation evidence.
limitations: Index does not name 28 districts or assess conflict.

title: Opportunities and Challenges of Climate Adaptation Policies, Republic of Moldova
temporal_coverage: Published February 2024; analysis based on information available through 28 November 2023 and disaster impacts over the preceding three decades.
methodology: IMF analysis uses ND-GAIN indicators, disaster records and macroeconomic modelling.
limitations: National and comparative estimates; modelled benefits are not observed project outcomes.

title: Moldova: Drought Portal country profile
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: Undated profile; statistics and referenced plans cover different years, including drought records through 2022 and institutional sources from 2019-2024.
methodology: FAO country profile compiles drought, livelihood, infrastructure and institutional indicators from listed sources.
limitations: The page does not date the profile or establish that older plans and arrangements remain operational.

title: Hydro-infrastructure rehabilitation to mitigate vulnerability to climate-driven extreme events in the Republic of Moldova
temporal_coverage: Project listed as active for 2024-2027; accomplishments and budget delivery are reported through 2025, with later work ongoing or planned.
methodology: UNDP project page describes design, pilot coverage, reported outputs and training.
limitations: Project outputs and training do not establish reduced flood losses or durable watershed-wide resilience.

title: Results of the Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Following the Dniester River Pollution Crisis Presented to the Public
organization: National Crisis Management Centre, Government of the Republic of Moldova
temporal_coverage: Government summary of the spring 2026 pollution crisis and the PDNA presented on 16 October 2026; full report was not yet posted on the page.
methodology: Government summary of a PDNA conducted with UN, EU and World Bank methodology and sector teams.
limitations: Only the official web summary was accessible; proposed recovery actions were still being finalized.
